en.headline: Hong Kong ToyCar Salon continues this weekend at Hopewell Hotel
en.dek: The three-day model-car exhibition in Wan Chai features more than 200 new releases, JDM display cars and a new aircraft model zone, running until Sunday.
body: Hong Kong’s largest model-car exhibition, the Hong Kong ToyCar Salon 2026, opened on Friday at the Grand Ballroom of Hopewell Hotel in Wan Chai and continues through Sunday.

Organisers said the sixth edition brings together more than 50 brands from Hong Kong, Macau, the Mainland, Japan, the United States and Europe, with over 200 model cars, railway models, bus models and aircraft models making their global or Hong Kong debut. A 1:1 scale JDM classic modified car and a miniature Hong Kong street scene are also on display.

Admission is HK$20, with free entry for people aged 65 or above holding a senior citizen card or identity card, persons with disabilities holding a valid registration card, and children under one metre in height. Opening hours are noon to 8 pm on Saturday and Sunday.

zh.headline: 香港車仔展2026周末續於灣仔合和酒店舉行
zh.dek: 為期三日的模型車展匯集逾200款首發產品、JDM真車及新增飛機模型區，今日及周日繼續開放。
body: 全港最大型模型車展覽「香港車仔展2026」周五於灣仔合和酒店16樓Grand Ballroom開幕，展期至周日。
主辦方表示，第六屆展覽雲集逾50個來自香港、澳門、內地、日本、美國及歐洲的品牌，展出超過200款模型車、鐵道模型、巴士模型及飛機模型，多款為全球或全港首發。現場並設1:1比例JDM經典改裝真車及微縮香港街景展示。
門票20元，65歲或以上持長者咭或身份證人士、傷殘人士持傷殘人士證，以及身高一米以下小童免費入場。周六及周日開放時間為中午12時至晚上8時。
